scope: Windows launcher implementation and V2 verification; W1.R, W2 and W3 remain open.
source_kind: working-tree; not yet wave-reviewed or committed

suites.kind: native Windows PowerShell and SLE paths
affected SLE, caller, ownership and exit-status regression

native_runs.flow: actual local start, stop, start, stop
actual E2E restart entry and stop
actual stack start, Dashboard-only audits and stop; no provider sync or browser opening

verification.all_normal_stops: reason=stop_command; stopped=true; forced=false; force_requested=false; actual service exit_code=0
negative_checks: foreign listener survives and an approved alternative port is selected
wrong command/start identity and identity reuse during waits refuse destructive escalation
missing controlled-stop identity and unsupported Windows signal fail
intentional stuck process is force-stopped only after its configured grace and is abnormal
nonzero or unknown service exit is not a normal stop
abnormal stop blocks setup/start in the same restart attempt
already-stopped no-op permits explicit recovery without rewriting prior failure
normal startup does not adopt orphan PID files
generic explicit grace override remains effective; Dashboard uses service-specific grace
source copy omits local credentials, databases and unrelated untracked files

retained_failures.superseded_worker_counts: 120 and 144 were before coordinator exit-status and ownership corrections.
retained_failures.root_cause: Exit status became available before the native process handle was signaled. SLE now waits on the retained handle within the original grace, rather than using one zero-time probe or fabricating zero.
retained_failures.early_log_gap: Some first worker-native process logs rotated before preservation; they are unavailable and are not counted as acceptance. Later attempts retain logs from run start.
